mode.description: Operation mode: 'enc' to encrypt, 'dec' to decrypt, 'info' to view parameters.

infile.description: Path to the input file to encrypt, decrypt, or inspect.

outfile.description: Path to the output file. If empty, output goes to stdout.

passphrase_method.description: Method to read the passphrase: 'dev:stdin-once', 'dev:tty-once', 'env:VAR_NAME', or 'file:PATH'.

env_var_name.description: Name of the environment variable containing the passphrase if passphrase_method is env:.

passphrase_file.description: Path to the file containing the passphrase if passphrase_method is file:.

force.description: Force operation even if excessive memory or CPU time is anticipated.

log_n.description: Work parameter logN (N=2^logN). Must be set with r and p to disable resource limits.

memory_limit.description: Max memory in bytes (M parameter). Ignored if explicit N, r, p are set.

memory_frac.description: Max memory fraction of available RAM (m parameter). Max 0.5. Ignored if explicit N, r, p are set.

time_limit.description: Max CPU time in seconds (t parameter). Ignored if explicit N, r, p are set.

p_value.description: Work parameter p. Required if --logN is set.

r_value.description: Work parameter r. Required if --logN is set.
